description: This Java source file defines the GangliaReporter class, which extends ScheduledReporter, and is responsible for reporting various metrics (gauges, counters, histograms, meters, timers) to a Ganglia monitoring system. It includes nested Builder class for configuration, methods for reporting different metric types, and utility functions for metric name sanitization and type detection.

classes.name: GangliaReporter
classes.description: A class extending ScheduledReporter that reports metrics to a Ganglia cluster, with configurable options via the Builder pattern.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Nested static class for building and configuring instances of GangliaReporter with various parameters such as prefix, tmax, dmax, rate/duration units, and executor.

methods.name: forRegistry
methods.description: Static method returning a new Builder for GangliaReporter.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a GangliaReporter instance with specified GMetric client(s) and configuration.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Overrides the report method to send all types of metrics (gauges, counters, histograms, meters, timers) to Ganglia.

methods.name: reportTimer
methods.description: Reports timer metrics, including durations and percentiles.

methods.name: reportMetered
methods.description: Reports detailed meter metrics such as count and rates.

methods.name: announceIfEnabled
methods.description: Helper methods to announce metrics if not disabled, for double and long values.

methods.name: announce
methods.description: Sends metric data to Ganglia via GMetric client(s).

methods.name: detectType
methods.description: Detects GMetricType based on the Java object type.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Extracts the group name from a metric name.

methods.name: escapeSlashes
methods.description: Sanitizes metric names by replacing slashes with underscores.
